review.posthog_relevance: Adds account management API capabilities and their corresponding tests, including account creation, permission scopes, and account group configuration checks.
review.reason: The chunk includes implementation and test changes for account-related API endpoints. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H1 add permission scopes and account-related action support. P1.F3.H1 adds account creation parameters. P1.F7.H4 adds account group configuration checks and account name/status assertions. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
